presets.uniform1dDesc: Constant velocity 12 m/s with zero acceleration
presets.accel1dDesc: Starting from rest with constant 2.5 m/s² acceleration
presets.brake1dDesc: Initial 20 m/s with -4 m/s² acceleration for stopping distance analysis
presets.parabolic2dDesc: Orthogonal independent motion with horizontal velocity and vertical acceleration
presets.realFrictionDesc: Surface motion with kinetic friction and dissipative deceleration

formulas.posExpl: Displacement relation over time under constant acceleration
formulas.velExpl: Instantaneous velocity variation with respect to time
formulas.torricelliExpl: Direct relation between squared velocity and displacement without elapsed time
formulas.frictionExpl: Opposing resistive surface contact force proportional to normal load
formulas.vecExpl: Orthogonal decomposition of planar displacement and velocity

steps.step1Title: Step 1: Observe uniform motion with zero acceleration
steps.step1Instr: Run simulation with acceleration set to zero and inspect the linear slope of the position-time graph.
steps.step1Hint: Under constant velocity, the position-time curve is a straight line with slope v.
steps.step2Instr: Select 'Braking & Stopping' preset and compare the simulated stopping distance to Torricelli's formula.
steps.step2Hint: Stopping distance is given by d = v₀² / (2|a|).
steps.step3Title: Step 3: Enable contact friction in Real mode
steps.step3Instr: Switch to Real mode and increase the friction coefficient to observe mechanical energy dissipation.
steps.step3Hint: Friction provides kinetic deceleration opposing motion until complete halt.
